about_description: OnionDrop manages persistent OnionShare receive services in a private, self-hosted web interface. Senders open an onion address in Tor Browser and upload files or messages directly to this server.
access_protection_copy: Protect the OnionDrop administration interface with a local username and password. This is recommended when the interface is reachable by other devices.
confirm_delete_inbox: Delete this inbox and all received files permanently?
empty_inbox_copy: OnionDrop creates persistent OnionShare receive services and stores every submission directly on this server.
enable_login_help: Require a username and password before the administration interface opens.
enable_login_settings_help: Login protection can be enabled or disabled at any time.
import_copy: Choose a persistent OnionShare JSON file created in receive mode. OnionDrop preserves its onion identity and stores future uploads in this app.
invitation_public:
Open this OnionDrop invitation in Tor Browser:
{url}
language_region_copy: Choose the default interface language. Each browser can also switch languages independently.
login_copy: Enter the credentials configured for this OnionDrop installation.
name: Name
no_files: No files have arrived in this inbox.
password_help: Use at least 10 characters. The password is stored only as a secure hash.
password_optional_help: Leave the new password empty to keep the existing one.
preview_not_available: A safe browser preview is not available for this format. Download the file to open it with a suitable application.
privacy_note_copy: Uploads travel through an onion service and remain stored locally. Treat files from unknown senders as untrusted.
require_private_key_help: Recommended. Public services can be opened by anyone who knows the onion address.
setup_copy: Choose a language and decide whether the administration interface should require a login. These settings can be changed later.
start_with_oniondrop_help: Bring this inbox back online after an application restart.
subject: Subject
tor_idle_description: Start an inbox to establish a private Tor onion service.
untrusted_warning: Received files are untrusted. Previewing is restricted to safer browser-rendered or text-only formats.
tor_connected_description: Active OnionShare services are reachable through the Tor network.
tor_connecting_description: OnionDrop is bootstrapping Tor and preparing the onion service.
tor_error_description: No service is online because a Tor or OnionShare process reported an error.
error_csrf_invalid: The security token is invalid. Reload the page and try again.
error_invalid_username: Use 3–40 letters, numbers, dots, dashes, or underscores for the username.
error_password_too_short: The password must contain at least 10 characters.
error_password_too_long: The password must not exceed 256 characters.
error_too_many_login_attempts: Too many failed attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
error_invalid_credentials: The username or password is incorrect.
error_request_too_large: The uploaded request is too large.
error_invalid_number: One of the numeric settings is invalid.
error_max_active_reached: The maximum number of active inboxes has been reached.
error_config_too_large: The OnionShare configuration is too large.
error_invalid_config: The selected file is not a valid OnionShare configuration.
error_receive_config_only: Only persistent OnionShare receive configurations can be imported.
error_missing_onion_identity: Start this service once in OnionShare before importing it so a persistent onion identity exists.
error_config_not_ready: The OnionShare configuration is not ready.
error_identity_not_ready: Start the inbox once before exporting its onion identity.
error_preview_not_supported: This format cannot be previewed safely.
error_value_not_ready: The onion address or private key is not ready yet.
